'''267''' ('''two hundred [and] sixty-seven''') is the [[natural number]] following [[266 (number)|266]] and preceding [[268 (number)|268]].

==In mathematics==
*267 is an odd [[composite number]] with two prime factors.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://mathworld.wolfram.com/CompositeNumber.html|title=Facts about the integer|website=mathworld.wolfram.com}}</ref>
*267 is the number of [[planar partitions]] of the number 12. Planar partitions are the number of ways in which the given number can be organized as split in an array.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mathworld.wolfram.com/PlanePartition.html|website=mathworld.wolfram.com|title=Planar partition information}}</ref>
*267 is the sum of perfect cubes in two different ways. It is the sum of 1<sup>3</sup>+2<sup>3</sup>+2<sup>3</sup>+5<sup>3</sup>+5<sup>3</sup> and 2<sup>3</sup>+2<sup>3</sup>+2<sup>3</sup>+3<sup>3</sup>+6<sup>3</sup>
*267 is the largest number that cannot be expressed as the sum of distinct [[Hexagonal number|hexagonal numbers]].
